items.exampleEn: Her innovative teaching methods make math fun.
items.exampleZh: 她創新的教學方法讓數學變得很有趣。

items.exampleEn: Our projection was wrong: we sold twice as many as we expected.
items.exampleZh: 我們的預測錯了：我們賣出的數量是預期的兩倍。

items.exampleEn: The airline gave us a free upgrade to business class.
items.exampleZh: 航空公司免費幫我們升等到商務艙。

items.exampleEn: The bridge project will take three years to finish.
items.exampleZh: 這項造橋工程要花三年才能完成。

items.exampleEn: Finishing the report is my priority this week.
items.exampleZh: 完成報告是我這週的優先事項。

items.exampleEn: The internet was one of the biggest innovations of the last century.
items.exampleZh: 網際網路是上個世紀最重大的創新之一。

items.exampleEn: The old factory is now utilized as an art center.
items.exampleZh: 那座老工廠現在被用作藝術中心。

items.exampleEn: Each picture has a corresponding word under it.
items.exampleZh: 每張圖片下面都有一個相對應的字。

items.exampleEn: Every child in the class dreamed of becoming an inventor.
items.exampleZh: 班上每個孩子都夢想成為發明家。

items.exampleEn: The teacher gave extra points for originality.
items.exampleZh: 老師為有原創性的作品額外加分。

items.sentenceEn: The city has made cleaner air its top priority this year.
items.sentenceZh: 市政府今年把改善空氣品質列為第一優先。

items.audioEn: I need to upgrade my phone, because the battery only lasts three hours.
items.audioZh: 我得把手機升級了，因為電池只能撐三個小時。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要升級手機？
options: It takes three hours to charge

items.sentenceEn: The company plans to utilize solar power in all its factories.
items.sentenceZh: 那家公司打算在所有工廠使用太陽能。

items.sentenceEn: Sales are projected to grow by ten percent next year.
items.sentenceZh: 預計明年的銷售額會成長百分之十。

items.stemEn: Teachers want students to show ____ in their stories, not copy ideas from books.
items.stemZh: 老師希望學生在故事裡展現原創性，而不是照抄書上的點子。

items.stemEn: The company is famous for its ____ products, such as a phone that folds like paper.
items.stemZh: 那家公司以創新產品聞名，例如一支能像紙一樣摺起來的手機。

items.passageEn: Lin Meihua is an inventor who works for a small company in Hsinchu. Her latest project is a cheap robot that helps farmers pick fruit. The company's top priority is to keep the price low, so the team utilizes simple parts that farmers can repair themselves. Many experts praised the robot's originality, and a magazine called it one of the most innovative designs of the year. The company's projection is that it will sell five thousand robots in the first year. Next spring, the team will upgrade the software, and each farmer will receive a corresponding user guide in Chinese or English. The boss says that real innovation means solving problems for ordinary people.
items.passageZh: 林美華是新竹一家小公司的發明家。她最新的計畫是一台幫農民採水果的便宜機器人。公司最優先的考量是讓價格保持低廉，所以團隊使用農民自己就能修理的簡單零件。許多專家稱讚這台機器人的原創性，一本雜誌還說它是年度最創新的設計之一。公司預計第一年賣出五千台機器人。明年春天，團隊會升級軟體，每位農民也會收到對應的中文或英文使用手冊。老闆說，真正的創新是為一般人解決問題。

questions.questionZh: 公司最優先的考量是什麼？
options: 讓機器人看起來很漂亮

questions.questionZh: 明年春天團隊會做什麼？
options: 把機器人的價格提高一倍
在日本開一家新的工廠

items.promptZh: 對我來說，家人永遠是第一優先。
referenceEn: For me, my family is always the top priority.
To me, my family always comes first; it is my first priority.
rubricZh: 「第一優先」可寫，例如 top priority、first priority 等
「對我來說」可寫，例如 for me、to me 等

items.instructionZh: 用 project 造一個句子，說說你正在進行或做過的一個專案或計畫。
referenceEn: I am working on a project to clean up the river in my town.
Last month, I started a project to design a new website for my team.
rubricZh: project 可當名詞或動詞（例如 a project、be projected to 等）
時態配合內容（例如 am working on、started 等）
